note: Campground behind a bar and fuel stop on US-2 at Saxon, about 4 mi south of Lake Superior (Saxon Harbor); the sites sit on gravel and grass loops north of the highway building. Pull-through sites; some 50-amp full hookups, mostly 30-amp. A 2026 camper report says the bar and grill has closed. Direct access to ATV and snowmobile trails. Mostly seasonal: a 2025 camper put seasonal campers at about 90% of the park; nightly, weekly and extended stays are offered. --Claude
